To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the realization of the smart grid is not a simple technical issue but a multi-actor and multi-level problem, which requires smart public policy intervention.
the realization of a smart grid requires a well-designed public policy intervention to overcome the overwhelming uncertainties of smart grid investments.
the introduction of market forces into the electricity sector in the Netherlands, and elsewhere in Europe, has resulted in a drastic change in the investment climate.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: What are the main drivers of the smart grid?
the role of government and the market in smart grid development and with the implications of smart grid development for the future of electricity networks.
the question how to deal with the challenges of smart grids within the context of the market paradigm.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
smart grid development in China is not a matter of if, but of when.
smart grid development in China will require public support, as well as the creation of an appropriate institutional setting.
the introduction of market forces and the fragmentation of markets has increased the complexity of the electricity infrastructure investment problem.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the introduction of market forces and the entrance of many new actors on the electricity market stage in the Netherlands have resulted in a fragmented electricity sector with many uncertainties.
smart grid investments are a multi-actor issue that needs public intervention to reduce the uncertainties.
the smart grid development process is a multi-actor process, which needs to be well-managed and supported by public intervention.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the introduction of market forces and the entrance of private investors in the electricity sector will not automatically result in a smooth and efficient development of smart grids.
the Chinese government should be aware of the importance of public support to realize smart grids.
the Chinese government will have to play an active role in the development and deployment of smart grid technologies.
